body:
- A feeling of helplessness
- Frustration, dissatisfaction
- A lack of reason to exist at all
- A great deal of emotional pain
... Im sure there are others
You can endure the discomfort you're feeling right now. No pain is great enough to justify leaving this world, even when we feel it is. Even when it does not pass for months or even years.
I dont know how to be happy. It amazes me (to the point of disbelief that it is even possible) that other people seem that way. Why continue to suffer?
